verification.notes: 38/39 tests pass across 14 test files (re-verified with a fresh full `npx vitest run`). The single failure, terms-acceptance.test.ts > recordAcceptance > handles a duplicate-acceptance race without throwing an unhandled error, throws a TypeError (Cannot destructure property 'rows' of '(intermediate value)' as it is undefined) from src/lib/terms-acceptance.ts line 70, an implementation file not read or modified by this tester role. The test asserts exactly the idempotent-resolve behavior locked in contract.md Interface 4's recordAcceptance catch block (on unique-violation error.code 23505, resolve { acceptedAt } without rethrowing or re-querying), so it is left failing as a true-positive regression signal rather than adjusted to pass artificially. All other suites (existing regression tests: env-config, gitignore, readme, scripts lint/format/build, typescript, health route; plus all 9 new files) pass. npm run lint, format:check, tsc --noEmit, and npm run build all pass with the new test files in place.

follow_ups: recordAcceptance's unique-violation (23505) catch path currently throws a TypeError instead of resolving idempotently, likely re-destructuring `rows` from a value that doesn't have that shape in the catch branch. Needs a coder fix to match contract.md Interface 4's signature details exactly.

getAcceptanceStatus (contract.md Interface 4) has no direct unit test of its own per test-plan.md's scope (only exercised indirectly via GET /api/terms-acceptance route tests); acceptable per the test-plan as written, but worth a direct unit test in a future round if its version-mismatch branching grows more complex.
